## Contact Policy

- **Course questions:** Please post questions about course content on the Slack channel so that all students can benefit from the answers.
- **Personal matters:** Contact the instructor directly via e-mail or Slack private message.
- **Problem set questions:** Post on Slack or come to office hours.
- **Expected response time:** I aim to respond to discussion posts within 24 hours on weekdays.
